latest_action.text: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.

card.summary: The S. 933, NASA Transition Authorization Act of 2025, authorizes funding for the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) for fiscal year 2025 at a level of $25,507,540,000 across its various mission directorates. The bill reauthorizes and updates numerous NASA programs related to space exploration, low-Earth orbit operations, space technology, aeronautics, science, and STEM education, while introducing new requirements for commercial partnerships, safety measures, and interagency coordination.
card.title: NASA Transition Authorization Act of 2025

card.summary: The NASA Reauthorization Act of 2026 authorizes appropriations for NASA for fiscal year 2026, setting total funding at approximately $24.44 billion across various programs including exploration, space operations, science, aeronautics, space technology, and education. The bill directs NASA to continue key exploration initiatives like the Artemis program, maintain operations and plan for the eventual deorbit of the International Space Station, support aeronautics and scientific research portfolios, and implement various workforce, technology, and reporting mandates.
card.title: NASA Reauthorization Act of 2026
